fields.Name: T271 - List Share Dialog Opens
fields.Description: Opens the ListSharingService-backed mj-list-share-dialog (ng-list-management), a per-record sharing code path with no equivalent in the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, select the Lists application, and stay on the default 'Lists' (Browse) section. On any list you own, click its '...' (ellipsis) more-options button to open the context menu, then click 'Share'. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the share dialog opens showing the sharing UI (permission levels and a way to add a user or role). Do NOT actually share — just confirm the dialog renders, then Cancel/close it.

judgeValidationCriteria: A list's '...' context menu opens and offers a 'Share' item (a lists-you-own must exist; if every list shows only 'Viewer access — read only', note that instead)
Choosing 'Share' opens a share dialog exposing sharing controls — permission level selection and/or an add-user/role input
Cancelling/closing the dialog returns to the lists view without sharing
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
